_readme: All on-screen text of the demo video. Times are seconds on the final video timeline (30 fps). Shots are the captured clips (the actions inside each clip are scripted in capture.mjs, relative to the shot start). *text* = emphasised. Every number in a caption (1.4×, ±10%, 13 of 14, …) must appear in the app text captured for that shot, or render.mjs stops; the optional check strings are looked for too, but only warned about. The voice-over (public/voice.mp3, made by voice.mjs) is timed to these caption start times: if a caption's text or start changes, regenerate or re-assemble the voice.

captions.text: Join MODIS and VIIRS fire records: Argentina seems to rise *1.4×*…
…on one scale, it fell: *0.7×*. The rise was the satellite.
Canada: doubled, not quadrupled. Official burned area agrees: *1.9×*.
A harmonized burning calendar, 2001 to October 2026…
…compare any month with its historical median.
Pick any place. Where the data cannot support a trend, it says so.
Checked year by year: within *±10%* in *13 of 14* years.
